subject: SIG evidence logistics & QA checklist for Acme Health
messages:
From: Samuel Cole <sam.cole@acme-health.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: acme-security@acme-health.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: SIG questionnaire — final artifacts and timeline request

Jonas,

Thanks for moving quickly here. We completed our review of the SIG responses and have a short list of final evidence items we need to close our vendor review: the latest SOC 2 Type II report (covering services through Sep 2026), a concise pen-test executive summary, ISO27001 statements (scope + cert ID if available), and your security slide deck for the technical review.

Can you confirm:
- Which of these you can provide unredacted, and which you prefer to provide in a redacted form?
- A target date to upload the artifacts to our secure Share folder (we typically need them within 3 business days to meet our procurement gate).

Happy to accept SFTP, secure Drive link, or an email with attachments. If there are any contractual NDAs or additional paperwork we need to sign before viewing, let us know.

Sam
Security Engineering
Acme Health

Attachments: (none)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Samuel Cole <sam.cole@acme-health.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — final artifacts and timeline request

Sam — thanks for the clarity and the artifact list. We're committed to getting these to you by the end of next week. High-level plan: 

1) Immediate: internal artifact intake and redaction decisions (today).
2) By 2026-11-14: upload SOC 2 Type II (redacted where necessary) + pen-test executive summary.
3) By 2026-11-15: upload ISO statement and security slides.

Action items (internal):
- Marissa: coordinate pen-test summary and redaction checklist.
- Rishi: confirm availability of the full SOC 2 report and produce a reviewer-friendly cover page.
- Laura: prepare the security deck export (PDF and PPTX) and call out any slides with customer-identifying content for redaction.

Sam — is Acme comfortable with us providing the SOC 2 and pen-test summary via a shared Drive link (we will enable viewer-only and a one-week expiry) or would you prefer SFTP?

I'll follow up in this thread with the QA checklist we use to validate items before sending.

— Jonas
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — final artifacts and timeline request

Looping in the artifact owners. I reviewed the pen test files this morning — we can produce an executive summary (one page) with high-level findings and mitigations; full report access will require an NDA (per vendor contract).

Quick artifact QA checklist (internal use):
- SOC 2 Type II
  - Verify report period matches Sep 2025–Sep 2026 (or note scope differences).
  - Confirm redactions: customer names, IP addresses, single-tenant logs.
  - Generate a 1-paragraph summary for external reviewers.
- Pen Test Executive Summary
  - Produce 1-page summary with severity breakdown and remediation status.
  - Vendor has redaction clause: share summary only, full report on NDA.
- ISO27001 statement
  - Provide cert ID and scope PDF if available.
- Security Deck
  - Export master deck + PDF; flag customer examples for redaction.

I'll attach the draft pen-test executive summary for review (attached as PenTest_Summary_Redwood_2026.pdf — draft). Rishi, can you confirm the SOC 2 cover page text I should use for the reviewer summary?

Marissa
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: PenTest_Summary_Redwood_2026.pdf (attachment stub, PDF, 1 page executive summary)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — final artifacts and timeline request

Team — attaching the SOC 2 Type II report cover + redacted PDF for reviewer distribution. I've created a one-paragraph summary for Acme that calls out scope and testing controls; see below. The full report is available under NDA.

SOC 2 summary (to include in external note):
"Redwood Inference SOC 2 Type II report (period: 2025-09-01 to 2026-09-30) covering common criteria for availability, security, and confidentiality. Selected control testing was performed by BrightAudit LLP; no critical control failures were reported. Detailed logs and per-customer evidence are redacted in the distributed copy; full evidence may be provided under contract/approved NDA."

I'm attaching: SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_2026.pdf (redacted distribution copy) and SOC2_CoverPage.txt (plain text summary). Marissa: you can use my summary verbatim when you upload.

Rishi
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_2026.pdf (redacted), SOC2_CoverPage.txt

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Samuel Cole <sam.cole@acme-health.com>, acme-security@acme-health.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Delivering SIG artifacts — Redwood (SOC2, pen-test summary, ISO note, security deck)

Sam — thanks for the patience. We uploaded the requested materials to a secured Drive folder and enabled viewer-only access with a one-week expiry. Links below; credentials not required. If you prefer SFTP, we can provision that as well.

Delivered items (distribution copies):
- SOC 2 Type II (redacted distribution copy): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SOC2-Redwood-2026
- Pen-test executive summary (1 page): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1PENT-Redwood-2026
- ISO27001 statement & cert ID: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ISO-Redwood-2026
- Security deck (PDF + PPTX): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Deck-Redwood-Acme

Notes and redaction policy:
- We provided redacted distribution copies for SOC 2 and the pen-test full report (vendor contract requires NDA for full reports). Redactions remove customer-identifying details and raw logs.
- Where Acme requires unredacted access for audit, we can coordinate an NDA and a secure review session with our InfoSec team.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm receipt and whether these distribution copies are sufficient for your procurement gate.
2) If you require the full pen-test report, indicate the appropriate NDA contact and we will kick off that process (target turnaround: 3 business days after NDA).
3) If Acme would like a short (20–30 minute) walkthrough of the security deck, we can schedule a call with Rishi and Marissa.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

— Jonas
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments uploaded: SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_2026.pdf, PenTest_Summary_Redwood_2026.pdf, ISO27001_Statement.txt, Redwood_Security_Deck_v2.pptx
